name: Olgard
description: Mia's father, a famed Skiltfolk shieldbearer and slayer based in Drunau who left her behind.

description_citations.text: "Sacrifice" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Mia writes to her father for help, but receives no reply.
timeline.quote: Mia broke down and wrote her father, scrapping a dozen drafts before settling on a brief and formal missive asking for aid.

citation.text: "Sacrifice" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2016.

relations.note: Daughter of the famed Skiltfolk shieldbearer who left her behind.
relations.quote: You don't think Olgard, famed Skiltfolk shieldbearer, would stand for the embarrassment of a daughter who couldn't defend herself, did you?

citation.text: "Sacrifice" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2016.
